facts.text: Ipswich, Queensland was originally called "The Limestone Hills", then "Limestone", before adopting the name of its English namesake in 1843.
The city boasts over 6,000 heritage‑listed sites, showcasing early colonial, Victorian, and Queensland Bungalow architecture that line its streets.
Ipswich has become a sought‑after filming spot, with movies like The Railway Man, San Andreas, and Inspector Gadget 2 shot around its railyards.
In 2016, Fire Station 101 opened as Ipswich’s digital innovation hub, positioning the region as a leader in the digital economy.
Looking ahead to Brisbane 2032, Ipswich is poised for significant growth in its visitor economy, welcoming more tourists to the area.
